Log In BOOK NOW LAKESIDE HOMESTAY Phone, Zalo (Ms. Minh): 0989.985.805 Locate Lakeside homestay on google map ​ https://maps.app.goo.gl/uub91vy3LpK8QtwH6 received_6641191995897701 press to zoom IMG_20220916_192948 press to zoom received_884815369313608 press to zoom received_6641191995897701 press to zoom 1/8 https://maps.app.goo.gl/YEWnEXwFVNpDgcLL6 Location map of Lakeside homestay and Like peninsula in Dong Do lake area Contact phone number Minh 0989-985-805. Follow the asphalt road to the lake, do not go on concrete or dirt roads. On the way, follow the sign "Lakeside homestay" as shown in the picture. When you get to Dong Do lake, follow the asphalt road along the lake where there are many homestays. Then follow the map to get to her house. Try to follow the instructions above, otherwise you will get lost on the dirt road along the mountainside which is very dirty and difficult to travel, especially when it rains. For any information needed please contact Lakeside homestay, Dong Do lake, Minh Tan village, Minh Tri commune, Soc Son, Hanoi Tel: 0989-985-805 (zalo) Email: minh151120@gmail.com Address on google map You can follow the directions on google map straight to Lakeside homestay without any further instructions. From Hanoi, you can take Nhat Tan-Noi Bai road, turn onto Highway 2, then turn right onto Highway 35, then go through the main gate of Hanoi Golf Course and you will be close to Dong Do Lake. Then continue following Google's instructions, note that you should not take the dirt road along the lake at the beginning of the dam because the road is a bit difficult to travel. You should follow the asphalt road where many villas are built, 1km from the dam, turn right over the concrete bridge (the road to Dong Mai Temple). After 50m over the concrete bridge, turn right onto the dirt road along the lake, go about 150m more and you will see the iron gate of Lakeside homestay. Submit Thanks for submitting! Address Contact (Ms. Minh) to deposit 30% of the money to complete the booking.
